Only investigational agent, given with the Stupp regimen named in the title ("XS005 Injection Combined With Stupp Regimen"); rule 4 applies if it is pharmacological. If XS005 turns out to be a cell/gene/viral/vaccine product, rule 0a (excluded_intervention_type) applies instead.

note: S6 depends entirely on what XS005 is, which the record does not say. XL (or the [LOOKUP]/clinical co-author step) should identify the product outside the registry; if it is a cell therapy, gene therapy, oncolytic virus or vaccine, the trial becomes excluded_intervention_type.
